dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is taking retail market share from SPACs

Dogecoin, with a current market capitalization of C$79 billion, is larger than all but 5 Canadian corporations (Royal Bank, Shopify, TD, Enbridge, Brookfield)

All the $DOGE has greater "value" than each of Thomson Reuters, CNRL, CP Rail, CN Rail, BMO, and so on
